title: Fenwick Tree
description: Write a Zig program that implements a Fenwick tree (Binary Indexed Tree) for prefix sum queries.
hints: Fenwick tree uses the least significant set bit: `i & -i`
`update` adds delta at index i and propagates to ancestors
`query` sums from index 1 to i by traversing downward
Use 1-based indexing for Fenwick tree operations
